title: MIXAR: Scaling Autoregressive Pixel-based Language Models to Multiple Languages and Scripts
abstract: arXiv:2604.11575v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Pixel-based language models are gaining momentum as alternatives to traditional token-based approaches, promising to circumvent tokenization challenges; however, existing models remain English-centric and are hard to train as generators. This paper introduces MIXAR, the first generative multilingual pixel-based language model, pretrained on eight high-resource languages spanning Latin and CJK scripts and scaled up to 0.5B parameters. Although pretrained on high-resource languages only, MIXAR generalizes to unseen low-resource languages better than a tokenizer-based model pretrained on the same corpus, with its largest gains on the scripts most distant from the pretraining mix, taking a step toward more equitable language technology. translated_title: MIXAR：将自回归的基于像素的语言模型扩展至多种语言与文字系统
translated_abstract: 基于像素的语言模型正日益成为传统基于词元方法的替代方案，有望规避分词带来的种种挑战；然而，现有模型仍以英语为中心，且难以作为生成器进行训练。本文提出了MIXAR，这是首个生成式多语言基于像素的语言模型，在涵盖拉丁文字和CJK（中日韩）文字的八种高资源语言上进行预训练，并将参数规模扩展至5亿（0.5B）。尽管仅在高资源语言上预训练，MIXAR在未见过的低资源语言上的泛化能力仍优于在同一语料库上预训练的基于分词器的模型，并且在与预训练语言组合差异最大的文字系统上收益最为显著，朝着更公平的语言技术迈出了一步。为了使自由生成能够在像素空间中实现，MIXAR用基于GRPO的强化学习阶段取代了以往基于像素模型中出了名不稳定的对抗训练阶段，该强化学习阶段通过奖励机制……
tldr: MIXAR是首个生成式多语言像素级语言模型，在八种高资源语言（涵盖拉丁与CJK文字）上预训练并扩展至0.5B参数，不仅能在未见过的低资源语言上超越基于分词器的模型，还用基于GRPO的强化学习取代不稳定的对抗训练，实现了像素空间中的自由文本生成。
en_tdlr: MIXAR is the first generative multilingual pixel-based language model, pretrained on eight high-resource languages spanning Latin and CJK scripts and scaled to 0.5B parameters, which outperforms tokenizer-based models on unseen low-resource languages and replaces unstable adversarial training with GRPO-based reinforcement learning to enable free generation in pixel space.
